# Wuzie

> Wuzie is a web app for sending bulk WhatsApp messages from the WhatsApp number a business already uses. Each message carries the customer's name, goes out at a careful pace that protects the number, and replies come straight back to that number.

Wuzie is made for small businesses: shops and online brands, schools and coaching classes, clinics and services, and agencies that run campaigns for several clients.

## How it works

- Link your WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business number by scanning a QR code, the same way WhatsApp Web works. No WhatsApp Business API and no Meta approval are needed.
- Upload your contacts, write one message with the customer's name in it, and send it to everyone.
- Wuzie spaces the messages out with random gaps, caps how many a number sends a day and pauses a campaign when too many messages fail.
- Replies arrive on your own WhatsApp number, so you answer them on your phone as usual.

## Facts

- Message types: text, images, documents and video. Native WhatsApp buttons and lists are not available on linked numbers; options are numbered replies the customer answers with a digit.
- Daily limit: a new number starts with a small daily limit that grows as the number becomes established, up to 1,000 messages a day per number. More numbers can be linked to send more.
- Ban risk: no tool can promise a number will never be banned. Wuzie lowers the risk with daily caps, random gaps and automatic pauses.
- Also included: contacts with message history, message templates, multiple numbers under one login and team roles.
- Accounts: set up on request through the Free Access form on the home page. Paid plans start with a 14-day free trial.
- Wuzie is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.
